name: JOJUNO Ceramic Canisters
imageAlt: Illustration of ceramic kitchen food canisters with wooden lids
description: JOJUNO White Embossed Ceramic Canister 3 Piece with Airtight Bamboo Lid Lead-free pantry storage
features: Larger Capacities for Bulk Storage - Ideal for households that need more space, this set includes three larger white ceramic canisters (30 oz, 48 oz, and 82 oz). Use them to store oats, flour, cereal, rice, and other dry goods in generous amounts—perfect for family kitchens or bulk storage needs.

Functional Sizes with a Decorative Touch - With Medium (4.0 x 4.0 x 5.6 in), Large (4.8 x 4.8 x 6.7 in), and Extra-Large (5.9 x 5.9 x 7.1 in) options, this trio of white ceramic canisters meets a wide range of storage demands while enhancing your countertop with its elegant embossed ceramic artistry.

Easy Access with Wide Mouth Design - Each white ceramic canister features a wide-mouth opening, making it easy to fill and scoop ingredients. Whether you're baking or prepping, your ingredients are always within easy reach.

Airtight Seal with Embossed Elegance - Made from durable white ceramic with embossed surfaces and bamboo lids, each jar includes a silicone ring that helps seal in freshness while keeping out air and moisture—preserving both taste and texture.

Simple to Maintain, Built to Last - The canisters’ smooth glazed white ceramic finish makes them simple to clean—just wipe or place in the dishwasher. Hand washing is recommended for the bamboo lids to extend their durability and maintain their snug fit.
